description: Public test vectors for Strix Portable Proof Bundle v1. ALL SYNTHETIC: issued with test keys derivable from test/helpers/synth.mjs. Never add these keys to a real trust store.

vectors.name: valid-allow-succeeded
vectors.description: ALLOW with a SUCCEEDED outcome, invocation and policy disclosed.

vectors.name: valid-allow-succeeded-jwks-trust
vectors.description: Same bundle, trust supplied as a plain JWKS.

vectors.name: valid-allow-no-outcome
vectors.description: ALLOW decision, no execution record in the store: execution is NOT established.

vectors.name: valid-deny
vectors.description: DENY decision: prevention is NOT established, outcome NOT_APPLICABLE.

vectors.name: valid-allow-tool-failed
vectors.description: ALLOW decision whose execution FAILED.

vectors.name: valid-approved
vectors.description: Approval fields present: reported as an export-time source assertion.

vectors.name: valid-unicode-disclosure
vectors.description: Disclosed arguments with non-ASCII keys (incl. astral), escapes and non-integer numbers.

vectors.name: valid-rotated-keys
vectors.description: Records signed by a retired key, manifest by the current key; both trusted.

vectors.name: valid-receipt-schema-1
vectors.description: Receipt schema 1 carries no tenant: subject says UNSPECIFIED.

vectors.name: valid-no-embedded-keys
vectors.description: No convenience key copy in the bundle.

vectors.name: trust-none-supplied
vectors.description: Valid bundle, no trust store: mathematics only, origin not authenticated.

vectors.name: trust-none-supplied-no-embedded
vectors.description: No trust store and no embedded key: signatures cannot even be checked.

vectors.name: trust-signer-not-in-store
vectors.description: Trust store does not contain the signer.

vectors.name: trust-wrong-key-same-id
vectors.description: Trust store has a different key under the signer's key id.

vectors.name: trust-revoked
vectors.description: Signer key is marked revoked in the trust store.

vectors.name: trust-outside-validity
vectors.description: Signer key used after its notAfter.

vectors.name: trust-other-tenant
vectors.description: Signer key is scoped to another tenant (cross-tenant confusion).

vectors.name: trust-rotation-old-key-missing
vectors.description: Rotated bundle, trust store lacks the retired key.

vectors.name: trust-attacker-resigned
vectors.description: Whole bundle produced by an attacker key that reuses the real key id and embeds its own public key.

vectors.name: trust-attacker-resigned-no-store
vectors.description: The same attacker bundle with no trust store: valid mathematics, never PASSED.

vectors.name: expect-wrong-receipt
vectors.description: Relying party expected a different receipt id (action substitution / replay of another bundle).

vectors.name: tamper-evidence-byte
vectors.description: One byte of an evidence artifact changed.

vectors.name: tamper-manifest-field
vectors.description: A manifest field edited after signing.

vectors.name: tamper-manifest-digest-and-artifact
vectors.description: Artifact replaced and its manifest digest updated to match, without the signing key.

vectors.name: tamper-artifact-replaced
vectors.description: Receipt replaced by another validly signed receipt from the same signer.

vectors.name: tamper-artifact-removed
vectors.description: A listed artifact deleted.

vectors.name: tamper-artifact-inserted
vectors.description: An unlisted file added that tries to supply enforcement evidence.

vectors.name: tamper-signature-swapped
vectors.description: manifest.sig.json taken from a different valid bundle.

vectors.name: tamper-signature-removed
vectors.description: manifest.sig.json deleted.

vectors.name: tamper-embedded-key-swapped
vectors.description: Embedded convenience key replaced with an attacker key.

vectors.name: tamper-native-receipt-field
vectors.description: Receipt decision flipped and manifest re-listed by someone without the key.

vectors.name: signed-subject-substituted
vectors.description: Signed manifest names a different receipt than the one it carries.

vectors.name: signed-tenant-substituted
vectors.description: Signed manifest names a different tenant than the receipt.

vectors.name: signed-bundle-id-wrong
vectors.description: bundleId is not the derived identifier.

vectors.name: signed-deny-with-outcome
vectors.description: A DENY receipt accompanied by an execution outcome.

vectors.name: signed-outcome-of-other-action
vectors.description: Outcome belongs to a different authorization.

vectors.name: signed-outcome-incoherent
vectors.description: Outcome says SUCCEEDED and carries an error code.

vectors.name: signed-outcome-before-decision
vectors.description: Outcome completion time precedes the decision.

vectors.name: signed-evidence-state-overclaims
vectors.description: Manifest claims an enforcement observation that v1 cannot carry.

vectors.name: signed-missing-outcome-called-not-applicable
vectors.description: ALLOW with no outcome, manifest says NOT_APPLICABLE instead of ABSENT.

vectors.name: signed-disclosure-mismatch
vectors.description: Disclosed arguments are not the ones the receipt was issued for.

vectors.name: signed-policy-disclosure-mismatch
vectors.description: Disclosed policy is not the version in the receipt.

vectors.name: signed-policy-says-deny-decision-allow
vectors.description: Disclosed policy maps the capability to DENY but the decision is ALLOW.

vectors.name: signed-receipt-hash-incoherent
vectors.description: Receipt evidenceHash does not match its own fields.

vectors.name: signed-unrecognized-decision
vectors.description: Decision value not defined in v1.

vectors.name: signed-export-before-decision
vectors.description: Bundle created before the decision it describes.

vectors.name: auth-valid-root-only
vectors.description: Relying party trusts only the issuer root; the bundle carries the gateway key's authorization.

vectors.name: auth-valid-supplied-out-of-band
vectors.description: Bundle has no authorization; the relying party supplies the one it holds.

vectors.name: auth-valid-revocation-checked
vectors.description: Revocation list from the root supplied; this authorization is not on it.

vectors.name: auth-valid-second-authorization
vectors.description: Two authorizations for the key; the first by id is expired, the second covers the record.

vectors.name: auth-valid-rotation
vectors.description: Records under the previous gateway key, manifest under the current one; each key has its own authorization.

vectors.name: auth-missing
vectors.description: Valid signatures, root trusted, but nothing authorizes this gateway key: issuer not established.

vectors.name: auth-no-trust-store
vectors.description: Authorization present, no trust store: it proves nothing by itself.

vectors.name: auth-issuer-root-unknown
vectors.description: Authorization signed by a root that is not in the trust store.

vectors.name: auth-issuer-root-impersonated
vectors.description: Authorization signed by an attacker key that reuses the real root's key id.

vectors.name: auth-gateway-key-substituted
vectors.description: Attacker signs with its own key under the gateway's key id and attaches the genuine authorization.

vectors.name: auth-scope-widened-by-gateway
vectors.description: Gateway edits its own authorization (adds a tenant) and re-signs the bundle; the root's signature no longer matches.

vectors.name: auth-expired
vectors.description: Record time is after the authorization's notAfter.

vectors.name: auth-not-yet-valid
vectors.description: Record time is before the authorization's notBefore.

vectors.name: auth-wrong-tenant
vectors.description: Authorization covers another tenant.

vectors.name: auth-wrong-environment
vectors.description: Authorization covers another environment.

vectors.name: auth-record-kind-not-authorized
vectors.description: Key is authorized for receipts and manifests, not execution outcomes.

vectors.name: auth-revoked
vectors.description: The root's revocation list names this authorization.

vectors.name: auth-root-revoked
vectors.description: The issuer root itself is marked revoked in the trust store.

vectors.name: auth-root-outside-validity
vectors.description: Authorization issued after the root's own notAfter.

vectors.name: auth-rotation-old-key-unauthorized
vectors.description: Rotation, but only the current key carries an authorization.

vectors.name: auth-receipt-signer-unauthorized
vectors.description: Manifest signer is authorized; the receipt was signed by a key nothing authorizes.

vectors.name: auth-root-used-as-record-signer
vectors.description: Bundle signed directly with the issuer root key: a root authorizes, it does not sign records.
